title: Shared Non-Copy State
goal: Combine Rc with RefCell to share and mutate non-Copy data across multiple owners.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: RefCell and Rc

sections.text: You will recognize shared ownership from reference counting in C++ or garbage collection in Java. `Rc` gives multiple owners access to a value, but only through shared references.
Combining `Rc` with `RefCell` grants both shared ownership and dynamic mutability. This pattern allows non-`Copy` data to be mutated through any handle.

sections.caption: Rc shares ownership while RefCell allows dynamic mutation.

sections.text: Calling `borrow_mut()` on an `Rc` handle reaches into the inner `RefCell` and gives exclusive write access. Keep guard scopes short so other handles can access the cell without panicking.

explanation: Combine Rc with RefCell to share and mutate non-Copy data across multiple owners.
